description: This PHP class 'TotalDurationModel' in the OrangeHRM' Time API models total duration data, including hours, minutes, and a formatted label, for use in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: TotalDurationModel
classes.description: A model class representing total duration with hours, minutes, and label, implementing serialization for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes TotalDurationModel with a duration in seconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the total duration into an array with hours, minutes, and a formatted label.
